Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Card text: "(D) Enter combat with a ready minion controlled
by another Methuselah. This acting vampire has +X strength
and +X capacity. Before the combat begins, each chosen
vampire must move 1 blood to the acting vampire or this action
is canceled."

Do all the effects in this text rely on the action not being
blocked (ie being successful)? If so, it's not nearly as
useful as I would have hoped. :-) Still great if you can
get the action through, but at no stealth, it's liable to be
just another Bum's Rush with no special effects. At least
you don't have to spend the 1 blood per vampire if you get
blocked (right?).

thanks,

Josh

disgusted entity (by the picture! not the text. ;-)

Right.

I would personally play this card in conjunction with Dawn Operation.
That way, you either get them with the +X oomph, or the agg damage. And
conveniently, you can have prevent cards in your deck and shrug off your
OWN agg in the resulting combat.

BEST situation would be with a TS/IG/US/SoS in hand, and play this card
with a Dawn Op as "bait". "Fine, you block? OK, I hit you for... 5
agg, then, instead of 4 normal." =)
